title: Agent OS Project Configuration
description: Created by /agent-os:setup. Read by all agents to adapt behavior to the project.

roleExtension.description: Per-role skill and doc overrides for a pipeline stage.

mode.description: extend = apply tech-adaptation first, then add these. replace = skip tech-adaptation for this role.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this role. Resolved in order: project, user, plugin.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill (agent-os:<name>).

docs.description: Doc file paths the agent reads before starting.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or relative to project root.

mode.description: extend = apply tech-adaptation first, then add these. replace = skip tech-adaptation for this role.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this developer role.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths the developer reads before starting.

items.description: File path.

scaffold_if_new.description: Skill name to run as a project scaffold before the first subtask. Applied only when project_type is 'new'.

agentExtension.description: Per-agent skill and doc overrides. Applied on top of any stage or role config for this agent. Agent mode wins over role and stage mode.

mode.description: extend = keep stage/role config and add these. replace = use only what is listed here, skipping tech-adaptation.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for this specific agent. Added on top of stage and role skills.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths this agent reads. Added on top of stage and role docs.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or relative to project root.

qaAgentExtension.description: Per-agent overrides for the qa-engineer. Includes extra agents and post-QA commands in addition to skills and docs.

mode.description: extend = apply defaults then add these. replace = use only what is listed here.

skills.description: Skill names to inject for the qa-engineer.

items.description: Skill name or prefixed plugin skill.

docs.description: Doc file paths the qa-engineer reads.

items.description: File path.

agents.description: Extra agent names to run in parallel with qa-engineer. Their findings are merged into the QA report.

items.description: Agent name.

commands.description: Commands to run after QA passes. External-effect commands require an approval gate.

items.description: Command name.

project_type.description: new = greenfield, existing = active codebase, legacy = old codebase to modernize

workspace_type.description: single = this directory is the project; monorepo = this is the git root with backend/frontend as subdirectories sharing one repo; multi-repo = backend and frontend are separate git repos inside this directory (root is not a git repo)

focus.description: Which developer roles are active. fullstack = backend-developer + frontend-developer; backend = only backend-developer (frontend subtasks are skipped); frontend = only frontend-developer (backend subtasks are skipped)

workspace_paths.description: Sub-directory paths for backend and frontend when workspace_type is monorepo or multi-repo. Paths are relative to the workspace root. Not used for single.

backend.description: Relative path from workspace root to the backend project directory.

frontend.description: Relative path from workspace root to the frontend project directory.

package_manager.description: e.g. bun, pnpm, npm, yarn, uv, pip, poetry, maven, gradle, go mod

test_command.description: Command to run the test suite

dev_command.description: Command to start the development server

build_command.description: Command to build the project for production

review_required.description: Whether human review is required before merging

track_state_in_git.description: Whether .agent-os/ files should be committed to git

require_architecture_approval.description: Whether the design stage requires explicit user approval before development

require_requirements_approval.description: Whether the discovery stage requires explicit user approval before planning

output_language.description: Language for all agent output and pipeline messages. en = English, es = Español

extensions.description: Optional skill, doc, agent, and command extensions for the pipeline. Managed via /agent-os:skills. Merged with ~/.agent-os/defaults.json (project takes precedence). See schemas/defaults.schema.json for the full shape.

context.description: Doc paths loaded by every agent in the pipeline, regardless of stage.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or path relative to project root.

agents.description: Per-agent skill and doc overrides. Merged on top of stage and role config; agent mode wins. Keys must be plugin agent names.
